## Professional summary
Subham Karmakar is a full-stack AI developer and B.Tech Computer Science student at Adamas University. He builds production-ready web, desktop, and AI products across the stack: Next.js and React interfaces, TypeScript and Python services, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Nginx, and practical LLM/RAG workflows.
